# FDG9015

> CONSIDER integrating your aggregate components with Visual Studio designers.

Framework Design Guidelines, 3rd edition, section 9.1.3 Aggregate Component Guidelines.

## How it is checked

- Check: judgment
- Automatic fix: no
- Severity: library suggestion, application suggestion, test none
- Status: draft

Not an analyzer candidate: implementing IComponent is visible, but whether a type is an aggregate component, and whether designer integration fits it, is judgment.

## From the book

Integration allows placing the component on the Visual Studio Toolbox and adds support for drag and drop, property grid, event hookup, and so on. The integration is simple and can be done by implementing `IComponent` or inheriting from a type implementing this interface, such as `Component` or `Control`.
